assignmentTitle: Design of a 2-Ton Mobile Scissor Lift Power Screw

criteria.title: Understanding Mobile Scissor Lift Application & Scope
criteria.description: Student reviews the Mobile Scissor Lift Project Charter and accepts the design brief for the 2-ton power screw mechanism.

criteria.title: Mobile Scissor Lift Component & Interface Identification
criteria.description: Accurate identification of 2-Ton Lifting Load & Platform, Upper Pivot, Scissor Arms, Central Crossing Pivot, Lower Fixed Pivot, Horizontal Power Screw, Threaded Travelling Nut Block, Screw End Support & Thrust Bearing, Handwheel/Drive, and Mobile Base & Caster Wheels.

criteria.title: Scissor Kinematics & Horizontal Power Screw Force Calculation
criteria.description: Accurate evaluation of scissor linkage equilibrium to determine critical horizontal thrust force (F_screw = 74.64 kN) at lowest angle (theta = 15 deg).

criteria.title: Power Screw Design Parameters & Given Data Confirmation
criteria.description: Correct identification of given engineering parameters (F_screw = 74.64 kN, d = 50 mm, p = 8 mm, 2beta = 30 deg, mu = 0.15, Dc = 70 mm, mu_c = 0.10, Syt = 380 MPa).

criteria.title: Screw Geometry, Core/Mean Diameters & Helix Angle
criteria.description: Accurate calculation of core diameter (dc = 42.0 mm), mean diameter (dm = 46.0 mm), and helix angle (alpha = 3.169 deg).

criteria.title: Virtual Friction Angle & Thread Friction Torque Calculation
criteria.description: Accurate determination of virtual friction coefficient (mu' = 0.1553), virtual friction angle (phi' = 8.827 deg), and thread raising torque (Tt = 364.76 N-m).

criteria.title: Thrust Bearing Collar Radius & Collar Friction Torque
criteria.description: Accurate calculation of mean collar radius (Rc = 35.0 mm) and thrust collar friction torque (Tc = 261.24 N-m).

criteria.title: Total Operating Torque, Overall Efficiency & Gearbox Requirement
criteria.description: Accurate calculation of total operating torque (Ttotal = 626.00 N-m), mechanical efficiency (eta = 15.2%), and justification for 15:1 gear reduction drive.

criteria.title: Self-Locking Condition & Fail-Safe Holding Safety Verification
criteria.description: Rigorous proof of the self-locking condition (phi' > alpha) and determination of positive lowering torque (Tlower = 431.31 N-m) ensuring fail-safe load retention.

criteria.title: Combined Core Stress Analysis & Factor of Safety Verification
criteria.description: Evaluation of direct compressive stress (sigma_c = 53.88 MPa), torsional shear stress (tau = 25.04 MPa), maximum combined principal stress (sigma_max = 63.72 MPa), and Factor of Safety (FOS = 5.96) on AISI 4140 steel.

criteria.title: Comprehensive Technical Design Report
criteria.description: Concise, structured engineering synthesis report integrating all kinematic forces, power screw geometry, torques, efficiency, self-locking safety, and stress verifications for the 2-ton mobile scissor lift.
